en.role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance
en.quote: The latest forecast from all three leading agencies—the Central Bank, the Finance Ministry, and the Economic Development Ministry—is that inflation this year will be around 10%.
en.head: Inflation reached 13.3% in 2008.
en.body: Rosstat recorded consumer-price inflation of 13.3% in 2008. The forecast Kudrin attributed to three agencies was about 10%. Both figures cover the full year.
